misc.text: #ONEPIECE1190 I also have Gaban over Oden.. Future sight, a massive advantage in CoC, and insane speed are more than enough for me. That’s why I also see a parallel to Luffy’s "wings" and Yamato, who will never surpass Zoro and Sanji. EoS: Ray ~ Gaban>Oden Zoro ~ Sanji>Yamato Dengekivinsmoke 🇲🇦 (@dengekivinsmoke) #ONEPIECE1190 Where does “Oden > Gaban” even come from? Why pusing that agenda ? To upscale Kaido ? ▫️The world knew Oden was part of Roger's crew ▫️It was made pretty clear that Oden ranked behind Roger, Rayleigh, and Gaban By that logic, EOS Yamato > EOS Zoro/Sanji 😭💀 — https://nitter.net/dengekivinsmoke/status/2084913263855174121#m
